body.p: This listing of claims will replace all prior versions, and listings, of claims in the application:
body.br:
Claim 1 (Currently Amended): An electrocardiography monitor, comprising:
a housing comprising rounded edges along top and bottom surfaces of the housing;
a processor secured by the housing;
an electrographic front end circuit to sense electrocardiographic signals;
a microcontroller secured by the housing, wherein the microcontroller is a microcontroller interfaced to the electrocardiographic front end circuit to sample the electrocardiographic signals; and
electrical contacts that protrude from the bottom surface of the housing to connect to a battery to power the microcontroller, wherein the battery is disposed between the microcontroller and skin of a patient. the processor.
Claim 2 (Original): An electrocardiography monitor according to Claim 1, comprising:
a seal coupling surrounding the electrical contacts.
Claim 3 (Original): An electrocardiography monitor according to Claim 1, further comprising:
further electrical contacts to establish an electrical connection with one or more electrodes for sensing the electrocardiographic signals.
Claim 4 (Original): An electrocardiography monitor according to Claim 1, wherein the housing is shaped for placement over the battery.
Claim 5 (Original): An electrocardiography monitor according to Claim 1, further comprising:
circuitry for an actigraphy sensor.
Claim 6 (Original): An electrocardiography monitor according to Claim 5, wherein the actigraphy sensor generates interrupt signals to the microcontroller based on a position of the housing.
Claim 7 (Original): An electrocardiography monitor according to Claim 1, wherein the housing comprises polycarbonate, ABS, or an alloy of polycarbonate and ABS.
Claim 8 (Original): An electrocardiography monitor according to Claim 1, further comprising:
flash memory configured to store the electrocardiographic signals.
Claim 9 (Original): An electrocardiography monitor according to Claim 1, further comprising:
an expansion port via which an external device interfaces to the microcontroller.
Claim 10 (Original): An electrocardiography monitor according to Claim 9, wherein the external device comprises a physiological sensor.
Claim 11 (Currently Amended): An electrocardiography monitor assembly, comprising:
a housing comprising rounded edges along top and bottom surfaces of the housing;
a processor secured by the housing;
an electrographic front end circuit to sense electrocardiographic signals;
a microcontroller secured by the housing, wherein the microcontroller is a microcontroller interfaced to the electrocardiographic front end circuit to sample the electrocardiographic signals memory;
electrical contacts that protrude from the bottom surface of the housing to connect to a battery to power the processor the microcontroller, wherein the battery is disposed between the microcontroller and skin of a patient.; and
a backing configured to receive the sealed housing.
Claim 12 (Original): An electrocardiography monitor assembly according to Claim 11, comprising:
a seal coupling surrounding the electrical contacts.
Claim 13 (Original): An electrocardiography monitor assembly according to Claim 11, further comprising:
further electrical contacts to establish an electrical connection with one or more electrodes for sensing the electrocardiographic signals.
Claim 14 (Original): An electrocardiography monitor assembly according to Claim 11, wherein the housing is shaped to fit over the battery.
Claim 15 (Original): An electrocardiography monitor assembly according to Claim 11, further comprising:
circuitry for an actigraphy sensor comprised within the housing.
Claim 16 (Original): An electrocardiography monitor assembly according to Claim 15, wherein the actigraphy sensor generates interrupt signals to the microcontroller based on a position of the housing.
Claim 17 (Original): An electrocardiography monitor assembly according to Claim 11, wherein the housing comprises polycarbonate, ABS, or an alloy of polycarbonate and ABS.
Claim 18 (Original): An electrocardiography monitor assembly according to Claim 11, further comprising:
flash memory configured to store the electrocardiographic signals.
Claim 19 (Original): An electrocardiography monitor assembly according to Claim 11, further comprising:
an expansion port comprised in the circuitry via which an external device interfaces to the microcontroller.
Claim 20 (Original): An electrocardiography monitor assembly according to Claim 19, wherein the external device comprises a physiological sensor.
